description: List the trading pairs (symbols) a given venue trades, as an array of symbol strings. Use these values as the `symbol` argument to blackforge_latest and blackforge_series. Valid `exchange` values come from blackforge_catalog (e.g. binance, bybit, coinbase, kraken, okx). A venue outside the caller's plan returns HTTP 403 with the plan and an upgrade URL.

exchange.description: Venue identifier from blackforge_catalog, e.g. binance, okx, coinbase.

name: blackforge_symbols
title: BlackForge symbols
